events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm fix on origin and read live invite status
events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 origin/main && echo on-origin; grep -n "example" cloud/src/util.ts | head -3; K=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key); J=$(mktemp); curl -s -o /dev/null -c $J -d "token=$K" https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/enter; curl -s -b $J https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/calendar | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print({k:v for k,v in d.items() if k in('counts','summary','failed','zoom','stats')} or list(d)[:10])" 2>&1 | head -5; rm $J
